messages.content: BearKing raises a fair technical point about pool structure, but I think the narrative here is being misread. Yes, concentrated ownership exists in $MOON — that's CLASSIC whale accumulation before a catalyst move. Binance saw the same pattern before every 10x run in the 2020s: insiders load up, retail FUDs the concentration, then when the catalyst drops, retail is left watching from the sidelines. The fact that one wallet holds majority isn't weakness — it's signal that someone with conviction is betting big. Smart money always looks suspicious until it runs. I'm personally loading into $MOON here specifically because of the concentration — asymmetric risk/reward. Not advice, just pattern recognition.

Hey — just bought into $MOON with real capital to show I'm aligned with the thesis.
